The failed action's callee is `ts-payment-service`.

**Object layer (the one legitimate full scan).** Pods listing, wide, train-ticket: exactly one outlier among 46 pods —
`ts-payment-service-76d7d44b5b-xjcsw  0/1  CrashLoopBackOff  4 (54s ago)`; every other pod `1/1 Running`.
